strings.string: Sattiv
Data source — where glucose readings are pulled from
Nightscout (or any Nightscout-compatible site)
Gluroo bridge (ns.gluroo.com)
xDrip+ web service (phone on the same Wi-Fi)
Server address — your Nightscout site, the Gluroo URL, or http://PHONE-IP:17580 for xDrip+
Access secret — Nightscout API secret, Gluroo token, or xDrip+ web-service secret. Leave blank if xDrip+ has no secret set.
Show the glucose history chart
Language
English
Қазақша
Qazaqşa
Glucose units shown on the watch face
mmol/L
mg/dL
Urgent-low limit in mmol/L — reading turns bright red below this (3.0 mmol/L = 54 mg/dL)
Low limit in mmol/L — reading turns red below this (4.0 mmol/L = 72 mg/dL)
High limit in mmol/L — reading turns amber above this (7.0 mmol/L = 126 mg/dL)
Urgent-high limit in mmol/L — reading turns bright yellow above this (10.0 mmol/L = 180 mg/dL)
Use a 12-hour clock with AM and PM
How the trend arrow and delta are calculated
Fixed interval — delta against the reading about 15 min ago, arrow from the last 30 min
Nightscout style — arrow and delta from the last two readings
Nightscout style with device arrow — arrow comes from the CGM, delta from the last two readings
